steps.name: A place called Devil's Mountain
steps.objective: After talking to [Sera] at the “Guild Inn”, go to [Lisione] at “Devil’s Mountain”.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Recently, several problems have been occurring in certain areas of the El Anor Mountains.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Well, monster attacks always happen wherever there are mountains... .

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: It feels very different this time.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: In the past, near the territory of the High Elves, which was called Bethesda and a mysterious paradise on earth... .

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: We have received information that monsters believed to be from the Demon World are appearing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A monster from the demon world? Are you saying a monster came over from the Demon World?

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: I don't know the details either.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: As for the guild union, I'm in a hectic situation right now due to various issues... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What can I do?

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Bethesda is the area where problems continue to occur. No, I mean… .

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Please go to the place now called ‘Devil’s Mountain’.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: We need a detailed investigation to find out what is going on there.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: There have also been incidents of people who frequently visited our inn disappearing while passing through the area.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: I really want to go there myself, but I can't... .

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Of all the people I know, I found %s, the person with the most skill and reputation.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: You've solved a lot of problems so far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That said, I'm a little scared.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Is that so? Still, I think Adventurer can do it... .

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Can I trust you with our mission to investigate Devil's Mountain?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will come back.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Please. Still, strange things keep happening here and there these days.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Oh, you're already gone. I was going to tell you that it got a little colder there... .

steps.name: collapsed hall
steps.objective: Defeat the 4 monsters in “Devil’s Mountain” and report to [Licione].

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Ah, I can’t believe someone is coming here again. Gallus has once again created a gap in the barrier and led you in.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It's dangerous here! Hurry and run away before it's too late!

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: When Gallus' army approaches, there is no escape.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gallus? Who is that?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: He is the devil who made this place like this.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I don't have time to explain leisurely.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: If you do it wrong, you could die, so run away quickly!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, can you explain a little more?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Recently, people have been going missing here. Could it be related to the demon Gallus?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'll say it again: Gallus is really dangerous. It's a devil of a different level.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I'm fine. Could you please continue speaking?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I know it's a serious situation, but I think I can help you only if I hear an explanation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Devil’s Mountain, right? Incidents of missing people keep happening... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It's not the Devil's Mountain. It was only called that because of Gallus. Originally, Bethesda was a place protected by a sacred barrier.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: However, the earthquake created dimensional rifts here and there, and monsters appeared within them.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: As a result, the Green Vegetation Clan I led was all but me... . every… . I lost my life.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: This beautiful land that I could not protect became a hideout for demons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . So what do you look like now... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: This is a curse placed by Gallus. It's a shame that I'm a high elf chieftain who can't even break the devil's curse.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I thought I had at least the power to deal with the devil... . Gallus… . Gallus… .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: (Lisione becomes angry, muttering Gallus' name. However, her anger soon subsides, as if she is fading away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me try to break the ice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Unbreakable ice, after all, is not ordinary ice. This is... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It's no use. It's not just ice, it's created by a curse... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Anyway, run away. I might die if I stay here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw this and I can't go back like this.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Really, you're an idiot. Is that what you say when you see this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I am that kind of person. So I can't just go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, please tell me everything you know.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Again, you are such an idiot… .

steps.name: Enter the Hall of Mysteries
steps.objective: Defeat [Ruvia] and [Minerva] who are controlling the “Hall of Mystery”.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: You are truly an amazing person. To kill Gallus' army that filled the mountain in one go... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I knew he wasn't an ordinary person, but... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: However, it is still dangerous, so please leave like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There you go again. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are some remnants left, but the mountain has been cleared to some extent, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where else can I go? What can I do?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: … It's going to be really dangerous from now on, but do you still want to keep fighting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give it a try since it's something I just started.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So there is no need to feel too burdened.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Then I'll tell you. There is a space called the Hall of Mysteries at the bottom.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It is a place where the Green Plants clan used to pray to the ancient god Goddess Ceres and gather to share their daily lives.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: In addition to those things, it was a place to study various natural phenomena.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Gallus' army has already taken over that place too. Gallus' associates are staying now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are they demons too?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I don't know exactly. Luvia and Minerva are strong demons.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Luvia, who commands the army, and Minerva, who destroys her opponents with force... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: From what I know, this is the information. Both are frighteningly strong beings... . Just in case, if you take care of those two, Gallus will definitely... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I think the reason they stayed here was to gather an army.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have something to ask. Licione. What they cursed you with was simply… .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Yes, that's right. They tried to torture me by trapping me under a curse. Many continue to watch the path to death... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the worst. I can't forgive you. There really is no such thing as a devil. No, it's possible because he's a real devil.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go right now and deal with those people in the Hall of Mysteries.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We will also find out how to lift Lisione's curse as much as possible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please wait a moment. Don't worry, just wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: You're back... . Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay? It seems like the curse has gotten worse in the meantime... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Those two didn't know. Just a subordinate following the strong Gallus... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The spirit Minerva and Luvia seemed to be like that too.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: There are many aspects of the Demon World, where there are demons and demons, that cannot be understood with common sense.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: In the end, they are just consumables used out of necessity.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: They are just chess pieces, and they probably don't know how to lift the curse of Gallus, who is above them.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'm fine. I'm just thankful you're back... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Thank you for returning safely. So please go back the way you came. please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Lisione… . It can't go on like this. I think we need to hurry and defeat that demon named Gallus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, where should we go next? Please tell me.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'll say it again, you're such an idiot. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Next is Devil's Canyon. There was a different name, but I can't remember it. There are many demons there, including Gallus... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: A dimensional gap discovered during the great earthquake, and a demon from the demon world emerged from it. He called himself Hoghan.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Gallus in the bitter cold... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That doesn't matter. I will meet Gallus and find a way to lift the curse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If there is a way to cast a curse, there must be a way to break it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So please wait just a moment like now. Because I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Ugh, I can’t believe I’m falling apart like this… .

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: If Lux's injuries had fully recovered, I wouldn't have been insulted like this by a guy like you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux?

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Yes, Lux. I guess you know Lux too. Yes, he stands tall as the monarch of the demon world. There was a time when I also served as a corps commander under him.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: After gathering my strength here, I went back to the Demon World and tried to take revenge, but it was all to no avail.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: I even relied on those stupid Minerva and Luvia, but I never thought this would happen.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: (Gallus shows a sneer to %s who is looking at him in front.)

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: To be defeated by a mere human... . It would have been less unfair if I had lost to Lux... .

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Hahaha, hahahaha!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The devil's laughter... It's disgusting.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have something I want to ask. Why did you place a freezing curse on Licione instead of killing her right away?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you just want to bother me?

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: What do you want? Do you want to hear the obvious answer? Then I'll answer you

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: When part of the barrier surrounding the mountain is lifted, humans called Adventurer enter to prove themselves.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: After hearing the circumstances of the poor frozen woman, I challenge and challenge myself. However, they cannot reach where I am.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: The woman must have once had hope that things would get better. The moment it turns into despair, that expression is so beautiful.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Hahaha, when Adventurer dies, the woman who gave up everything screams. That sadness, that pain… . It is the greatest power for demons.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Hahahaha, hahahaha... .

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: I guess that's the answer now, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I break the curse?

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: There is no way to break my curse. Just walk and it's over.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: I wanted to use that feeling of wanting to help that elf woman more, but it's over now.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: So, watch that woman freeze to death in front of you and fall into despair!!

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: It is my last gift to die to humans and such.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Hahaha, khahaha, khahaha... … .

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: (As Gallus's laughter diminishes, the body supporting him falls apart.)

steps.name: a story told
steps.objective: Talk to <Sera Acelot> at the “Guild Inn”.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: You came back safely. I'm fine. so… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You say you're okay even in this situation... .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'm more worried about you than I am. I am satisfied that you came this far with a good heart.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: You came back safely, so I'm just thankful for that. I won't forget it even after I die.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: sorry. There was nothing I could do. I wanted to be a little more helpful... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I… . I am… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Instead, I will do everything I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything you would like to ask?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: are you okay. You have done a lot so far. I am satisfied. so… .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Oh, then can you just listen to me?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It's no big deal. Please be my last memory. I really didn't want to be left alone and disappear. so… .

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: So… . Could you please stay with me for a moment so that my last days will not be lonely?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I want to tell you a story from my childhood. A peaceful time in the elf village... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, willingly… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As I sit next to Licione and listen to her story, I am reminded of what Bethesda looked like a long time ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's such a beautiful story. Now, let me tell you why I came here. Is that okay? Licione… , Lisione?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Liscione, Liscione... . Open your eyes. Licione… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So… I went on an adventure to find Iris, and this is where I met you. and… , and… .

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Something like that happened... .

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: It breaks my heart that the devil tormented him so much.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: I'm sorry. Because I can't help you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Licione must have gone to a good place. If I get a chance later, I'll go see you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If only I knew more about demons and the demon world, if only I had gone a little faster... .

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: %s did his best. So don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: I'm sorry because I think I may have entrusted you with a request that was too difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: no. Don’t worry too much about Sarah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think things related to demons will gradually increase...)

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: What are you thinking like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing... . I thought about what happened there again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I was a little worried about what to do next. It's obvious what needs to be done, but still... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, I'll go now. Then see you later Sarah.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Yes, we are always here so please come see us later if anything comes up. Senior Platinum also said that.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Oh, you're already gone. Anyway, cheer up.
